symbols.name: positive constant
symbols.meaning: A positive constant multiplying $n\log n$ in the lower bound $T_A(n) \geq \sigma\, n\log n$ for machine $A$.
symbols.quote: that for each fixed machine $A$ there are a constant $\sigma>0$ and a threshold input length $n_0$, depending on $A$, with $T_A(n) \geq \sigma\, n\log n$ for all $n \geq n_0$.

symbols.name: threshold input length
symbols.meaning: The input length from which the lower bound on $T_A(n)$ holds for machine $A$.
symbols.quote: that for each fixed machine $A$ there are a constant $\sigma>0$ and a threshold input length $n_0$, depending on $A$, with $T_A(n) \geq \sigma\, n\log n$ for all $n \geq n_0$.

symbols.name: Big-Omega notation
symbols.meaning: The notation $\Omega(g)$ for the functions that are at least a positive constant times $g$ for all large inputs.
symbols.quote: Here $\Omega(g)$ denotes the functions that are at least a positive constant times $g$ for all large inputs.

relations.quote: In this model the lower-bound question is decided by the [limit inferior](limit-inferior.md) of the ratio $T_A(n)/(n\log n)$.
Costs in this model are measured against [Schönhage–Strassen multiplication](schonhage-strassen.md).
This model restricts [the n log n optimality conjecture](n-log-n-conjecture.md) to one machine at a time.
In this model, lower bounds are stated with [Big-Omega notation](big-omega-notation.md).
